# Xuanbao Industrial Materials Knowledge Center

> Technical reference system by Yancheng Xuanbao Environmental Technology Co., Ltd.
> covering activated carbon, adsorption materials, molecular sieves, catalysts and
> industrial treatment engineering: material properties, adsorption and catalytic
> mechanisms, engineering conditions, testing, selection and standards.
> Commercial site: https://xuanbaoenvironment.com/

## Core Knowledge Areas

- [Home](https://data.xuanbaoenvironment.com/): the knowledge center overview with explore-by paths.
- [Activated Carbon: Technical Guide](https://data.xuanbaoenvironment.com/activated-carbon/): properties, pore structure, forms, raw materials, selection, regeneration, gas and water applications.
- [Zeolite Molecular Sieves Guide](https://data.xuanbaoenvironment.com/molecular-sieves/): 3A/4A/5A/13X/NaY/ZSM-5 selection, adsorption mechanism, regeneration, concentration wheels.
- [SCR DeNOx: Complete Guide](https://data.xuanbaoenvironment.com/scr-denox/): V-Mo-Ti chemistry, plate vs honeycomb, poisoning, ammonia slip, activity testing.
- [CO Oxidation: Complete Guide](https://data.xuanbaoenvironment.com/co-oxidation/): catalyst families, light-off temperature, bed design, deactivation.
- [VOC Catalytic Oxidation: Complete Guide](https://data.xuanbaoenvironment.com/voc-catalysts/): Pt/Pt-Pd/non-precious systems, deactivation, lifecycle, space velocity.
- [VOC Treatment Engineering Guide](https://data.xuanbaoenvironment.com/voc-engineering/): adsorption engineering, RCO vs RTO, LEL safety, combined systems.
- [Water & Purification Guide](https://data.xuanbaoenvironment.com/water-purification/): activated carbon in water treatment, PAC vs GAC, contact time.
- [Testing & Analysis Guide](https://data.xuanbaoenvironment.com/testing/): activity evaluation, sampling, laboratory characterization, reading test reports.
- [Emission Compliance Guide](https://data.xuanbaoenvironment.com/compliance/): standards, CEMS, reporting and audit.
- [Methodology & Data](https://data.xuanbaoenvironment.com/methodology/): data classification, sources and evidence levels, technical terms.
